_comment: MissionHillsHappyHour seed data. vendors[] -> vendors collection; happyHours[] -> activities collection (--no-host-grouping). Happy hours weekly (recurDays Dart Mon=1..Sun=7), anchored to a past Monday.
_source: Mission Hills happy hours and discount windows. Happenings live in MissionHills_Activities.json, not here.

vendors.name: Fort Oak
vendors.tagline: Wood-fired steakhouse in a restored 1920s auto showroom
vendors.description: Brad Wise steakhouse known for a 40-day dry-aged ribeye, a raw bar and wood-fired cooking. Oyster Monday and a five-day happy hour on the bar and patio.
vendors.address: 1011 Fort Stockton Dr, San Diego, CA 92103

vendors.name: Communion
vendors.description: Rooftop restaurant atop The Sasan with panoramic coastal skyline views, a shared-plates menu with seafood and vegan options, daily happy hour and Sunday brunch.
vendors.address: 901 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103
vendors.hours: Dinner daily from 4pm; Sunday brunch 10am-2pm; happy hour daily 4-6pm, all night Mondays

vendors.name: Cardellino
vendors.tagline: A midwest chophouse crossed with a trattoria
vendors.description: Brad Wise Italian restaurant with artisan pasta, steaks and sustainable seafood, plus a short nightly happy hour.

vendors.name: Aero Club Bar
vendors.description: Long-running India St bar with a 1,200+ bottle whiskey collection, a Dyno Bar arcade room next door, an independent burger and taco kitchen, and the cheapest published happy hour in the neighborhood.

vendors.name: Pizza e Birra
vendors.description: Italian pizzeria with four happy hour days a week, a daily lunch special and Thursday trivia.
vendors.address: 3625 India St Ste 101, San Diego, CA 92103

vendors.name: Jo's Mission Hills Diner
vendors.tagline: Contemporary American diner, Diners Drive-Ins and Dives
vendors.description: Corner diner at W Washington and Falcon with a fully priced happy hour. Featured on Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives for its braised short rib French dip and bacon-wrapped meatloaf. Free parking behind the restaurant.
vendors.address: 807 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

vendors.name: Sushi Deli 1
vendors.description: Sushi restaurant with a split-service weekday schedule and a twice-daily happy hour.
vendors.address: 228 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Fort Oak - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $10 cocktails (lemon drop, gimlet, margarita, old fashioned, espresso martini); $10 wine by the glass; $6 beer; Food $8-$21 (fries $8 to burger $21). Bar and patio only, not the dining room. Walk-ins only, first come first served.
happyHours.address: 1011 Fort Stockton Dr, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Fort Oak - Oyster Monday
happyHours.description: $1 oysters on the half shell; $10-$12 cocktails; $10 wine by the glass; $35-$40 bottles of bubbles. Bar and patio only. Walk-ins only, no reservations.
happyHours.address: 1011 Fort Stockton Dr, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Communion - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: Prices not published. Daily 4-6pm per the venue's own site. Mondays run happy hour pricing all night, seeded separately as an activity. No prices published.
happyHours.address: 901 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Cardellino - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: Prices not published. Days and times from the venue's own site. No prices published; collect in person.

happyHours.title: Aero Club Bar - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $5 all beers; $5 wells; $5 house wines. Daily from open until 7pm. Open is 2pm Mon-Thu and 12pm Fri-Sun, so the window is longer on weekends.

happyHours.title: Pizza e Birra - Happy Hour (All Day)
happyHours.description: $12 wings, fried goat cheese, bruschetta, meatball app, cheesy garlic bread or pizza fries; $5 off any small pizza; $7 all drafts; $6 rotating draft. All day Tuesday, Wednesday and Sunday. Dine-in only.
happyHours.address: 3625 India St Ste 101, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Pizza e Birra - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $12 select appetizers; $5 off any small pizza; $7 all drafts; $6 rotating draft. Thursday 3pm to close, overlapping trivia at 6pm. Dine-in only.
happyHours.address: 3625 India St Ste 101, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Jo's Mission Hills Diner - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $6.50 mimosa; $6.50 16oz craft draft; $7.50 all wines by the glass; $8.95 grass-fed burger; $6.95 lumpia 3pc / $10.95 5pc; $9.95 tuna and toast points; $13.95 steak and onions; $9.95 roasted brussels sprouts and bacon; $9.95 warm spinach and artichoke dip; $4.95 frites; $6.95 sweet potato fries; $9.95 loaded tater tots. Closed Tuesdays. Burger add-ons: side upgrade $3.50, cheese $2.50, avocado $2.75, chili $3.50, fried egg $2.00, bacon $5.00.
happyHours.address: 807 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Jo's Mission Hills Diner - Weekend Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $6.50 mimosa; $6.50 16oz craft draft; $7.50 all wines by the glass; $8.95 grass-fed burger. Weekend window is shorter, 3pm to 5pm.
happyHours.address: 807 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Sushi Deli 1 - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $2 off select options (edamame, crab lagoons, fried calamari, garlic shishito peppers, fried gyoza, mussel dynamite); $2 off draft; $2 off drink specials. The venue publishes only the $2 discount, never base or final prices, so no item price can be stated.
happyHours.address: 228 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103

happyHours.title: Sushi Deli 1 - Happy Hour
happyHours.description: $2 off select options; $2 off draft; $2 off drink specials. No Sunday happy hour published.
happyHours.address: 228 W Washington St, San Diego, CA 92103
